note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting improvements.
title: Annual number of people requiring immediate assistance due to landslides
subtitle: Landslides are sudden movements of material down a slope, including wet mass movements (such as mudflows triggered by heavy rain or melting snow) and dry mass movements (such as rockfalls).
